# Qodalis CLI plugin development

Intro text before the first section is ignored.

## Overview

Section intro.

### Architecture

Commands are processors registered through modules.

The engine parses each line and calls `processCommand`.

## Web plugins

### Command processors

A command is a class implementing ICliCommandProcessor.

```typescript
// ## not a heading inside a fence
### also not a heading
class CliGreetCommandProcessor implements ICliCommandProcessor {
    command = 'greet';
}
```

Use `context.writer` to print output.

### Reading input

The input reader asks the user for text, passwords and confirmations.

```typescript
const name = await context.reader.readLine('Name: ');
```

### Testing

Web plugin tests are Jasmine specs.

Run them with pnpm nx test.

## Server plugins

### Node.js processor

Server commands extend CliCommandProcessor and return text.

Register with builder.addProcessor.

### Testing

Server tests use vitest, xUnit or pytest.

## Recipes

### Ask before a destructive action

Confirm with readConfirm before deleting anything.
